run_logging_server: run a fastapi server on localhost port 8000 that receives litellm log events
call_log_event_endpoint: send a POST request with JSON data to the log-event endpoint to log it
review_log_event_function: review the log_event async function that parses incoming JSON and prints received data
summarize_log_event_endpoint: summarize the log_event endpoint that accepts POST requests and returns a success message
test_log_event_endpoint: test the log_event endpoint by sending a JSON payload and verifying the response
